items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: A customizable bar chart component with animations, hover effects, responsive design, and support for both vertical and horizontal orientations with filled or outline variants

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: A line chart with multiple series, faithful gap handling, four curve interpolations, accessible inspection, gradient areas, and geometry-matched loading states

items.name: scatter-plot
items.title: Scatter Plot
items.description: A scatter and bubble chart with area-scaled bubbles, clipped viewports and trends, keyboard and touch inspection, and points that grow at fixed coordinates

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Pie Chart
items.description: A customizable pie and donut chart component with animated segments, interactive hover effects, center labels, and responsive design

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: A multi-axis radar chart with explicit axis ranges, polygons that grow from the center, keyboard and touch inspection, and responsive labels

items.name: stacked-bar-chart
items.title: Stacked Bar Chart
items.description: A stacked bar chart with faithful signed stacks, growth from zero, segment inspection by keyboard and touch, and vertical or horizontal layouts

items.name: gauge-chart
items.title: Gauge Chart
items.description: A 270-degree arc gauge with truthful range limits, nonoverlapping color zones, animated value updates, and keyboard and touch inspection

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap Chart
items.description: A grid, radial and stock heatmap with explicit missing values, faithful color scales, weighted areas, and keyboard and touch inspection

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel Chart
items.description: A funnel chart component with vertical trapezoid and horizontal diminishing bar variants, animated segments, conversion rates, and interactive tooltips

items.name: treemap-chart
items.title: Treemap Chart
items.description: A squarified treemap chart component for hierarchical data with nested rectangles, animated layout, interactive tooltips, and responsive design

items.name: waterfall-chart
items.title: Waterfall Chart
items.description: A waterfall chart component visualizing cumulative increases, decreases, and running totals with animated floating bars and connectors
